title: Hair-Trigger Alignment: Black-Box Evaluation Cannot Guarantee Post-Update Alignment
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on post-update alignment in domains of safety, privacy, and honesty.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
